title: The Bird in the Colosseum
paragraphs: The next day, led mainly by Older Sister, we decided to go hunting at sea. Hunting at sea is ideal for boosting the strength of Father’s group, after all. It seems one of our goals is to obtain a shield for use underwater.
“What should I do?”
“For now, just focus on making money and gathering materials. As for the rest… once the Filolials you registered hatch, raise them.”
“Got it!”
I’ve finally received permission to raise the Filolials, so now I just have to wait for them all to hatch. Ah, I’m so excited I can hardly stand it. My head is full of dreams… my heart is racing!
“Is that really okay?”
“I’ve already warned you not to go buying and raising them endlessly. Judging by Filo’s example, they all look like they’ll grow up to be big eaters.”
“It’s going to get pretty lively, huh?”
“Hey, Master—where are you going today? The guy with the spear isn’t coming, is he?”
Hmm? It seems Filo-chan is worried about me. What a delightful turn of events.
“Don’t worry, Filo-chan. I’ll definitely come running later!”
“Don’t come—!”
Filo-chan is full of energy again today! I’ll follow Filo-tan’s example, be full of energy, and live each moment to the fullest!

And so, our days in Zeltoble began. Starting with Kou, whom we managed to secure, and while also training Luna-chan and the others, we spent the first week entirely focused on setting up our living environment, following Father’s instructions. After all, this is Zeltoble.

Come to think of it, I spotted some folks who looked like Ren and Itsuki. Given the time of year, they might be here. Since the trip back via the portal takes just a moment anyway, and I know they still plan to operate in Melromarc for a while, they’ll probably just head back on their own as long as we don’t interfere. And with Father and my Older Sister here, it doesn’t seem like it’ll be too difficult to get our daily lives settled.

To start things off, it seems Father sold the supplies he’d gathered to a merchant to build up some connections. We’ve rented a house on the outskirts of Zeltoble. Even though my portal lets them go anywhere, they say they’ll be using this place as their base for a while. Father mentioned that lodging costs would get too high if the group got any bigger.

Also, Older Sister has found quite a few treasures through salvage work and built up some capital; with that money, she bought Filo-tan a horse-drawn carriage, which made her very happy. My older sister seems to have gotten used to life in Zeltoble as well; unlike when she was in Melromarc, she’s been tying a bandana around her head and helping out Older Sister.

Other than that, she goes peddling with Filo-chan. Since Zeltoble’s territory is smaller than Melromarc’s, there are relatively few domestic trade routes. In fact, there are far more routes leading out of the country.
“Hmm… Raph, pet Kou for me.”
“Sure, sure. Kou-san sure is a little clingy, isn’t he?”
“Ehehe—”
Now that he’s become the Filolial King, Kou has turned into a child who often seeks affection from his older sister. He’s usually hanging around her, just like right now.
“Kou, raised by Motoyasu, gets along well with Raphtalia, doesn’t he?”
“U, uh…”
Kou seems a bit nervous around Father. Father, seeing Kou like that, looks rather amused. I’m starting to feel amused myself.
“Since he’s got a good sense of propriety, he seems easier to handle than Filo.”
“Ehh! Filo’s way more useful!”
“That attitude alone says it all.”
Father and Filo-chan seem to be having a fun conversation. I want to join in too!
“Huh!? The guy with the spear is coming closer!”
Whenever I get close, Filo-chan ends up hiding behind Father. Oh, how cruel…
“Not again…”
Father is looking at me and Filo-chan with an exasperated expression.
“By the way, Father. Has Kou been behaving himself?”
“Hm? Ah, he hasn’t caused any trouble, and unlike Filo, he’s quite well-behaved. He’s taken a liking to Raphtalia, too, so I’m thinking of letting her manage him as his personal Filolial…”

What?! Kou is being highly praised by Father. This is the same Kou who once got scolded by Father for trying to eat Keel and Mole. And to think he might even become my older sister’s personal Filolial… What an immense honor!
“Oh, that’s wonderful. Kou, make sure to protect your older sister well.”
I’m happy that Kou is getting such high praise. Above all, if Kou can build a relationship with my Older Sister here, it’ll boost my standing too. So, I really want Kou to do his best.
“Got it!”
“Now then, Motoyasu. Do you know why this guy acts just like you do from Filo’s perspective, hiding in Raphtalia’s shadow?”
Kou looks a bit nervous as he hides behind his Older Sister, watching me, Filo-chan, and Father. He seems much more subdued from the start than the Kou I know. What kind of change is this?
“Oh my! Naofumi-chan, aren’t you scaring Kou-chan?”
“……Did I do something to this kid?”
“I don’t think you did anything in particular. It’s just that you scolded Filo the other day, didn’t you? Maybe that’s what scared him?”
“Ah… yeah, that did happen.”
I see… The other day, Filo-tan was reluctant to stay home alone and got scolded by Father. Maybe that scene is still burned into Kou’s memory.

That said, I don’t think it’s all that strange. In a previous loop, Kou had once underestimated my kind Father. Even for a gentle Father, Kou’s behavior—openly declaring he’d attack and eat Keel and Mole—was simply too much to bear, so he gave him a stern lecture. After that, Kou didn’t try to eat Keel or Mole, and he stopped disrespecting Father.

And now, seeing Kou being so subdued around Father… well, you know. Kou is a strong-willed child when he’s energetic, so perhaps he’s just not comfortable with someone like Father right now. It’s the same psychology as when a boisterous boy goes quiet in front of a scary teacher.
“He was being so selfish that I even had The Slave Trader in Zeltoble renew his monster crest.”
“Ugh… Master, you’re trying to keep the spear-wielder and Filo in the same place.”
“Sadeena and Raphtalia were there too, weren’t they? You should be able to put up with that much.”

Filo-tan is a bit of a shy one this time around. Even so, I can really feel how she’s enjoying her days to the fullest. Being able to watch that scene unfold right beside her makes me feel absolutely wonderful. Unlike in the previous loop, I can actually feel that Filo-tan is really here. My stress gauge is constantly at zero. I’m so mentally fulfilled that I could fight at full strength at any moment. It’s all thanks to Filo-chan.
But, you say Kou gets along well with Big Sister? Maybe that’s only natural.
“I kind of understand why Kou’s so attached to Big Sister. After all, he got along well with her in the first world and in the other worlds, too.”

To be precise, he was especially close to a creature that resembled her, but I suppose that’s just a minor difference. To begin with, Kou has a bit of a joker’s streak, and he’s a real foodie. In the previous loop, he even tried to eat Itsuki’s hair, a Mole, and Keel. Come to think of it…
“Actually, he got along better with your late Older Sister’s friend than he did with you.”
Your late Older Sister’s friend—such a nostalgic memory. She was a person of truly noble spirit. She was so kind to Kou that I remember her well, too.
“…Deceased?”
“That’s right. She was a friend from before Big Sister met Father.”
Big Sister’s eyes widened, and her expression turned slightly sad. Older Sister quickly stepped in to comfort her.
“…Depending on the loop, could she be saved?”
Father sensed the tension and turned to ask me.
“That’s right.”
“…Sigh. Is it already too late?”
Father asked me and Big Sister. Big Sister nodded.
“Yes… Refana… passed away right before my eyes.”
“That’s right. I suppose a few days after summoning was about the limit.”
“…I see.”
“Refana-chan, huh. Such a sweet girl… It’s so sad to think she’s gone…”
My Older Sister and her Older Sister murmur thoughtfully, lost in their own thoughts.
“Hm? Hmm?”
Kou, Filo-chan, and the Filolials nearby are exchanging glances, looking a bit flustered by the somber atmosphere. It’s absolutely adorable.
“Filo-chaan!”
“Yay! Master!”
“You guys need to read the room!”
Oh, Father just scolded me.
“Naofumi-sama…”

“I know. Normally, ensuring my own safety would come first, but because of Motoyasu… things have gotten pretty tied up. I intend to proceed with the original plan of securing Raphtalia’s village companions. I’m already building the connections needed for that.”

As if to reaffirm his resolve, Father clenched his fist. Oh, I knew you were building connections, but so that was your plan, was it? As always, I’m constantly amazed by Father’s strategy, which is as vast as the ocean. He really is something else.
“I’ve asked The Slave Trader here to look into sourcing them, so it shouldn’t be too difficult. Raphtalia and Sadeena want to compile a list of the villagers’ names, so please help them out.”
“Y-yes.”

Father and Big Sister are currently studying the Melromarc script that I translated. They seem to be picking it up quite quickly, though. I hear Big Sister’s Older Sister can already read and write a little.

“Based on Motoyasu’s testimony, it seems we can recreate the situation in Melromarc by having the Filolials and others handle the drug sales… as long as I stay out of it directly. After all, the Holy Bird Saint—who’s shaking up Melromarc’s religion—doesn’t need to show his face.”
Oh… it seems Father is thinking things through and acting accordingly.
“Kukuku… it seems there would be problems if I went too far without considering profits, and striking the right balance looks tricky, but it’s not impossible.”
Father is smiling with a look of amusement. This brings the end of the Three Heroes Sect one step closer.
“Still… it feels like I’m just following a walkthrough. It’s like I’m doing the same thing Ren and Itsuki did, and I can’t shake this uneasy feeling…”
Father’s expression has turned serious as he murmurs this. Hahaha! There’s no way Father would make the same mistakes as Ren and Itsuki!
“What should I do, then? Should I go hunting again and gather various items?”
“That’s necessary too, but there are other things you can do in Zeltoble.”
Oh? So I’ve got a job to do. Leave it all to me! No matter how difficult the mission, I’ll definitely pull it off.

“Motoyasu, you just need to make full use of that ridiculously strong power of yours at the Zeltoble Colosseum. I’ll register you as a sponsor anonymously. Oh, and don’t forget to make sure your cover isn’t blown.”

Apparently, Zeltoble has its own unique rules, and it seems that close associates or merchants who team up with Colosseum fighters can improve their social standing. This is the quickest way to gain trust and a track record without relying on my status as a Hero, all so I can use the Dragon Hourglass in Zeltoble.

While it’s possible for an individual to use the Dragon Hourglass by paying a huge sum, they’re probably saying it would become too much of a hassle when you factor in not only the ladies but also Filo-tan, Filolial, and the villagers who’ll be joining us soon. So, they’ve decided it’s more advantageous to become famous under a pseudonym and ensure we can use it freely. I take my hat off to Motoyasu.
“Got it! So I just have to fight, right? Destroy!”
“I think you probably only understand about half of that.”
“What a coincidence—me too.”
“Oh my—”
“Raphtalia and Sadeena are probably more attuned to that sort of thing, so please make sure Motoyasu can lie low effectively.”
“I think that’s the hardest order I’ve ever been given…”
“Ah… I know. I’m asking this even though I know it’s a stretch. I’m counting on you.”
“I’ll… do my best.”

And so, on Father’s orders, I ended up participating in the Zeltoble Colosseum to earn money and gain fame. I can’t wait to get my hands dirty. I’m going to slaughter every last one of them. Hahaha, you’re all going to die!
…Oh? Was the bloodbath supposed to be in the back colosseum? If it’s the main one, I’ll settle for just beating them half to death.
“First, we’ll have to disguise myself so no one recognizes me as the Hero… like covering my face, right?”
“Then let’s use the Filolial-sama’s feathers to make a mask.”
“We’ll have to register a fighter name, too.”
“Ah, I plan to register as a sponsor as well.”
“A fighter name, you say! Then ‘Filo-tan Love Guard No. 1’ would be perfect!”
“Master…”
Filo-tan is calling out to Father in a voice that sounds like she’s clinging to him. Oh! Filo-tan is head over heels for my athlete name, too! I’m suddenly feeling motivated. Hmph! That’s right!
“Oh, for heaven’s sake… Motoyasu, rejected!”
“What?! Even though Filo-tan is cheering me on, is it still a no?”
“If that sounds like cheering to you, your ears are just for show.”
Haven’t my Motoyasu ears been running at full blast ever since then? Father and the others are giving me exasperated looks. What on earth are they so dumbfounded about?
“Just pick something else for now. Using ‘Filo’ in your ring name is off-limits. There are other no-gos too, so come up with something else.”
“I guess I have no choice. ‘Perfect Hide Justice’ is the ring name Itsuki uses, so that’s a no-go.”
“Wait a second. A ring name just came up that really piqued my interest… Tell me about it later.”
Oh? Are you curious about Itsuki’s ring name? I see. You’re all going to make fun of him, aren’t you? When that happens, I’ll point and laugh right along with you.
“Naofumi-sama, we’re getting off track.”
“Ah, that’s right.”
“Then how about ‘Filolial LOVE’ or ‘Servant of the Angels’?”
“…That’s the kind of naming sense that makes whoever says the ring name sound incredibly pathetic. The theme is consistent, but isn’t there anything else?”
“Hmm, why wouldn’t those work?”
“Put yourself in my shoes—I’d be the one sponsoring a guy with a name like that.”
And with that, he rejected them in a firm tone. …What’s so wrong with them? I don’t get it at all. But since Father says no, there must be a good reason.
“If we’re going to make a mask out of the Filolials’ feathers and enter the competition, wouldn’t ‘Filolial Mask’ be a good name?”
My older sister suggested. Filolial Mask, huh? That’s actually not a bad idea, is it?
“True, from a Colosseum perspective, that approach could work…”
Father nodded after thinking for a moment.
“That’s probably the kind of thing Motoyasu himself could get behind. Motoyasu, what do you think?”
“No problem at all! Starting today, I’m Filolial Mask!”
Just as I expected from my Older Sister. So, I’ll be fighting in the ring wearing Lord Filolial’s mask… I’ll become the Colosseum’s bird!
It’s Quay!
The prize money will go toward helping my less fortunate sister’s fellow slaves. It’s pretty cool—just like some pro wrestler!
“So Motoyasu’s ring name will be Filolial Mask… Motoyasu, when you’re lying low in Zeltoble to avoid being recognized as the Hero, use that name.”
“Quay!”
“Leave it to me!”
“That’s fine. Also, in the Colosseum, refrain from using Skills as much as possible. Don’t hold back either. You must fight without letting anyone realize you’re the Hero.”
Taking those words to heart, I fashioned a mask from the feathers shed by Lord Filolial and his companions. I put it on my face and struck a pose in front of Father and the others.

Since I’ve already raised quite a few Filolials, I’ve secured enough feathers to make my own gear. By the way, it’s all made from feathers that fell out naturally. After all, I’m a “clean” Filolial Mask.
“What do you think, Father! With this, have I transformed from The Love Hunter into the Filolial Mask?”
I showed off the finished Filolial Mask outfit to Father and the others. I think it turned out pretty well, if I do say so myself—what do you think?
“Ah… well, I guess it does kind of look like a bird-man.”
“That cape is really making a statement, isn’t it?”
“That said, something this flashy might go over well in a place like that. Still, it reminds me of something… I guess it’s better than being half-naked.”
“Should I take it off?”

The time has come to show off my physique, honed through past experiences and the loops. Unfortunately, I’m the type who looks thinner in clothes, so you might not be able to tell just by looking. But believe it or not, I’ve actually got quite a bit of muscle. Since I’m running around day and night with the Filolials, I’ve developed some functional muscle. Vroom!
“Don’t take it off.”
“Oh my—”
“But this mask… it just doesn’t quite feel right, you know.”
I take off the mask and take another look at it.
“You were the one who said you wanted to make a mask out of the Filolials’ feathers and wear it… Won’t it get stuffy in this heat? They do love to swarm around people, after all.”
“Naofumi-sama, they do tend to cling to you, don’t they?”
“Hmm! I get it!”
I pull Filo-tan’s feather out of my pocket and attach it to the top of the mask as a decorative feather. It’s a recreation of Filo-tan’s signature feature—one she no longer has.
“All right, then.”
